descricao_original: A sharp transition in the mucosal epithelium, from stratified squamous moist (esophagus, right) to simple columnar (cardiac stomach, left), marks the transition of these two organs. Additional features of the stomach include the presence of gastric pits extending from the surface into the gastric glands in the lamina propria. This region is also referred to as the gastro-esophageal junction. 40x
